title: Actuarial Basis of the Commuted Value of Remaining Certain Installments — Income Annuities
content:
The commuted value of the remaining certain installments of an Ashgrove Income Annuities period-certain contract is the present value, at a stated discount rate, of a counted number of level installments.

## Basis

**Count.** The commuted value counts the certain installments not paid before the date of death, which is the tier's period-certain years multiplied by the installments per year, less one installment for each payment date from the first payment date through the date of death. Installments per year are 12 for monthly, 4 for quarterly, 2 for semiannual and 1 for annual payment; a payment period is accordingly 1, 3, 6 or 12 months.

**Value of each installment.** Every counted installment is valued at the current installment on the contract.

**Discount rate.** The installments are discounted at the contract's pricing interest rate plus the tier's commutation discount spread, taken as an annual effective rate and converted to a rate per payment period: one plus the annual rate, raised to the power of one divided by the installments per year, less one.

**Discounting.** The first counted installment is discounted one payment period and each later one a further payment period; discounting an installment for a number of periods means dividing it by one plus the per-period rate, raised to the power of that number of periods.

**Total.** The commuted value is the total of the discounted installments, rounded to the cent. Only the total is rounded.

## Worked figure (hypothetical contract)

| Input (hypothetical) | Value |
|---|---|
| Tier | Ashgrove Income Annuity 10-Year Certain, monthly installments |
| First payment date | 1 January of year 1 |
| Date of death | 15 March of year 4 |
| Current installment | $1,000.00 |
| Pricing interest rate | 4.00% |
| Commutation discount spread of the tier, taken as | 1.00% |

- Installments per year 12; period-certain installments 10 multiplied by 12, that is 120.
- Payment dates from 1 January of year 1 through 15 March of year 4: 36 in the first three years and 3 in year 4 (January, February, March), 39 in all. Count: 120 less 39, that is 81.
- Annual rate 5.00%; per-period rate: 1.05 raised to the power of one twelfth, less one, that is 0.40741% a month.
- Present value: $1,000.00 discounted one month, plus $1,000.00 discounted two months, and so on through 81 months, totals $68,872.97.
